# Session Start Checklist

Use this at the beginning of each rice work session.

1. Confirm current branch and working tree status.
2. Confirm active goal for this session in one sentence.
3. Choose one agent profile for the task focus.
4. Choose one skill recipe to apply.
5. Define a tiny deliverable that can be tested quickly.

## Session Goal Template

`Goal: implement <single visible improvement> for <theme> without breaking existing workflow.`

## Good Example

`Goal: add active-workspace pathway indicator in Quickshell for LOTM theme.`
